methods.label: Compare cookie areas
methods.explanation:
Equal amounts of dough at the same thickness give equal total cookie areas. Thus the friend with the largest individual cookies gets the fewest cookies.

Using the given bases and perpendicular heights, the areas of one cookie from each friend, in square inches, are
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{Art: }&\frac{(3+5)\cdot3}{2}=12,\\
\text{Roger: }&4\cdot2=8,\\
\text{Paul: }&3\cdot2=6,\\
\text{Trisha: }&\frac{3\cdot4}{2}=6.
\end{aligned}
\]
Art's cookie area, \(12\) square inches, is greater than each of the other three areas. Therefore Art gets the fewest cookies, choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
